Screaming In The Basement (2025) – Wishlist Now!

Step into the unknown with Screaming In The Basement, a psychological horror game that plunges you into the depths of a haunted house. Every room holds terrifying secrets, and every shadow hides something sinister. Can you uncover the truth before it’s too late?

Wishlist now to be the first to experience the terror. Can you escape the basement… or will you become part of its haunted history?
